correctness.rationale: For sufficiently small parameter values the hypotheses force a single moving top-side truncation. Exact integration gives \(f(t)=\frac{w}{a+b}(x+b)(2a+b-x)\) with \(x=he^t\). Direct differentiation factors the logarithmic-curvature numerator as \(-2xG(x)\), where \(G(x)=ax^2+(4ab+2b^2)x-ab(2a+b)\). Since \(G\) is strictly increasing on \(x>0\), its unique positive zero is the displayed \(h_*\), yielding all three cases including the non-log-concave endpoint. A symbolic replay independently confirms the algebra; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The anchor paper explicitly raises relaxation of symmetry and supplies an isolated one-axis counterexample. The result converts that example into a complete sharp local phase boundary for the natural family obtained by varying the isosceles triangle and the one active rectangle side. The endpoint behavior is mathematically substantive: zero curvature exactly at the center parameter still fails two-sided local log-concavity. This is a motivated structural classification rather than a numerical recomputation.
